texts.zh:
首席考古学家[leader.GetName]最近变得越来越孤僻。[leader.GetHeSheCap]像是对研究项目越来越漠不关心，反而沉迷于那些迄今为止发现的所有日记与日志。[leader.GetHeSheCap]还总是嘟囔着：“这些人该有多孤独啊。”

这也许是荒凉的挖掘现场的造成的负面影响。我们可以为整个小队提供一下心理咨询，或者相信[leader.GetName]，让[leader.GetHisHer]在工作中想出解决方法。
texts.en:
Chief archaeologist [leader.GetName] has been growing steadily more withdrawn of late. [leader.GetHeSheCap] appear[leader.GetSXX] less invested in our research goals, choosing instead to obsess over the various diaries and logs we have uncovered so far. [leader.GetHeSheCap] often mutter[leader.GetSXX] about "how lonely these people must have been".

It is possible the bleakness of this dig site is taking a toll. We can arrange for team-wide counseling, or else trust that [leader.GetName] finds resolution in [leader.GetHisHer] work.

label.zh: 安排一下，队员的健康最为重要。
label.en: Make arrangements. Our team's health is of utmost importance.

label.zh: 让[leader.GetHimHer]去吧，说不定[leader.GetHeShe]真的发现了什么呢。

texts.zh:
首席考古学家[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]现在不知所踪，随[absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]一同消失的还有一大批人类学数据。队员汇报称一辆地面载具失踪，不过我们的保护服还留在基地里。

[absconded_archaeologist.GetName]有可能跑到冻土带的另一处潜艇居住地去了。不过出于实际考虑，我们必须做好最坏的打算。
texts.en:
Chief archaeologist [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] has absconded, taking a sizeable portion of our anthropological data with [absconded_archaeologist.GetHimHer]. The team reports one ground vehicle missing, but all our environment suits remain at the base.

It is possible [absconded_archaeologist.GetName] escaped to another submarine habitat somewhere across the tundra, but realistically... We must assume the worst.

texts.zh: 考古学家[leader.GetName]付出了惨重的代价。尽管大家看上去相当疲惫，但[leader.GetHeShe]还是重新回到了团队之中，并提出了一个令人信服的猜想。我们似乎忽略了几个个人文件汇总中的微妙细节。总之，这些线索将协助我们，带来团队一直期望的突破。
texts.en: A heavy toll has been exacted upon archaeologist [leader.GetName]. Though they appear quite haggard now, [leader.GetHeShe] has rejoined the team and presented a compelling hypothesis. It seems we had overlooked several subtle details in the corpus of personal documents. Together, these clues provide just the sort of breakthrough we had been hoping for.

label.en: But was it worth the cost?
